Allegedly the last direct descendant of Joseph of Arimathea, his coming is predicted in the Estoire del saint Graal. This knight of the round table is the son of Lancelot and Elaine of Corbenic. He wrote Songs and Proverbs of William Blake for the baritone Dietrich Fischer-Dieskau. The foundation named for this activist was responsible for healthy care and both building homes and providing pensions to the elderly. Founded by Robert Noyce and Gordon Moore as N.M. Electronics, this company was renamed when Andrew Grove came on board. His recent works have focused on the waning days of the great American middle-aged male, while his earlier works discussed the American Jewish experience. It consists of three groups, the Line Islands, the Phoenix Islands, and the Gilbert Islands; the latter was the name of this country when it was a British protectorate. While in prison, he met the writer Rustichello, to whom he dictated his memoirs. The resultant book, Divisament dou monde, is sometimes called Il milione due to its great number of falsehoods. Also called Aeaea after the name of her island, she concocted a poisonous drug whose only antitode is moly, brought by Hermes. She purified Jason and Medea of Absyrtus's murder before asking them to leave her island. For 10 points—name this enchantress who turned Odysseus's shipmates into swine.
